summary: 9 m of kerb at a three-way junction; no room to stop.
reasons: Junction corner, not a parking kerb

drivers.seclusion: Bush opposite, but a house sits 16 m away on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Line is on the junction mouth where roads merge; stopping would block the turn.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the south side further along, not at the corner.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over and north of the junction.
